meta.title: OctoTechnology — kind apps for children aged 2–7
meta.desc: OctoTechnology makes stories, learning games, coloring pages and trucks with Mark the Cat for children aged 2–7. No ads, no losing, safe for kids.
hero.title: Kind apps where little ones learn through play
hero.sub: OctoTechnology makes apps for children aged 2–7: stories, games, coloring pages and trucks with Mark the Cat. No ads and no losing — just joy and a little learning every day.

shelf.lead: Every app is like a little book with its own adventure. Tap a book to open it.

video.lead: A short reel from all our apps. Tap an app below to jump to its part.
video.full: Full trailers with sound are on each app's page.
apps.title: Get to know each app 🐾
apps.lead: What's inside, who it is for and where to find it.
mark.title: Meet Mark the Cat 🐱
mark.lead: A ginger cat in round glasses is a kind grown-up friend for little ones. He never tests or scolds — he asks for help, shows the way when your child is unsure and celebrates every success.
mark.motto: “You can do it — Mark is right here.”
mark.r1d: Reads stories and shows new words in TwoMeows
mark.r2d: Builds and washes trucks in Mark's Garage
mark.r3d: Flies in on a balloon in Mark the Cat
mark.r4d: Brings pictures to life in Mark's Art
mark.r5d: Tidies up with your child in Mark's Home
parents.title: Made with care for parents 👨‍👩‍👧
parents.lead: The same promises work in every app of the family.
parents.c1d: A wrong move just gently bounces back. No red, no error sounds, no timers.
parents.c2d: No ads and no links to other sites — only the game and learning.
parents.c3d: Our games collect as little data as possible, and most collect none at all. Every policy is public.
parents.c4d: Settings and purchases sit behind a gate that little hands can't open.
parents.c5d: Play on the road, at the cottage or on a plane.
parents.c6d: Mark speaks up to 17 languages, and children don't need to read.
kids.title: And for kids it's just play ⭐
kids.lead: Every task ends with a celebration and a little gift.
kids.f1: 🎈 Balloons, confetti and parties after every task
kids.f2: 🗣️ Mark's warm voice explains everything simply
kids.f3: 👆 Big buttons and easy gestures for little fingers
kids.f4: 🎁 Gifts, stickers and pictures that come alive
studio.title: About the studio 🐙
studio.lead: OctoTechnology is a small independent studio. Like an octopus, we have many hands — and each one makes a new app for children.
studio.p1: We start every game by watching how children really play, and we only keep what a two-year-old can manage on their own. Our apps work on Android, and iPhone and iPad versions are on the way.
